find:
-- [AnimePlayer: queue tab] menu row 1 is the Queue entry, playlist item n is row n + 1
		local from, to = event.from_index - 1, event.to_index - 1
		if from < 1 or to < 1 then return end
		mp.commandv('playlist-move', tostring(from - 1), tostring(to - (to > from and 0 or 1)))
replace:
-- [AnimePlayer: queue as a tab, move] row n is playlist item n again
		mp.commandv('playlist-move', tostring(event.from_index - 1), tostring(event.to_index - (event.to_index > event.from_index and 0 or 1)))
